test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters K, A, S, N, T and I. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face K?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12232626bd41df1e94f71ce693826b9d847606074987d6584a9e3fd967f5a5ae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06014ef40cd3013892169488dba0d2a6209090ebf992b9759d53f96479e6674e.png]
solution:
The given positions of the dies are: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12232626bd41df1e94f71ce693826b9d847606074987d6584a9e3fd967f5a5ae.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06014ef40cd3013892169488dba0d2a6209090ebf992b9759d53f96479e6674e.png] 

Consider the positions of the dice 1 and 2. Face 'A' is common for both the position, keep that face constant and moves in a clockwise direction, we get the faces opposite to each other.
